title: CDLAttestation
description: Signed attestation produced by mobile device after on-device liveness verification. Contains NO raw biometric data.

session_id.description: UUID generated by relay server. Links attestation to the web browser session that initiated it.

challenge_id.description: UUID of the specific challenge sequence issued. Single-use. Server rejects reuse.

challenge_response.description: Ordered comma-separated list of challenge steps completed. Example: 'blink,look_left,smile'. Must match challenge_sequence issued for challenge_id.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of liveness completion on device. Server rejects if older than 120 seconds at time of receipt.

assurance_level.description: IAL2: hardware attestation present + all layers pass. IAL1: software liveness only, device lacks hardware attestation but layers passed. software_only: reported when hardware attestation is absent. Relying party decides acceptance.

layer_scores.description: Per-layer results. Numeric scores 0.0-1.0 only. NOT biometric data. Cannot reconstruct face from these.

layer2_challenge_completed.description: true if all required challenge steps were completed

layer2_challenge_score.description: Confidence score for challenge completion quality

layer3_pulse_detected.description: true if rPPG POS detected physiological pulse signal

layer3_bpm_in_range.description: true if detected BPM is between 50 and 110

layer4_lbp_score.description: LBP texture analysis score. 1.0 = confident live texture

layer4_fourier_score.description: Fourier spectrum score. 1.0 = no screen replay artifacts

layer5_microsaccade_detected.description: true if natural involuntary eye movements detected

device_attestation.description: Base64-encoded hardware attestation token. iOS: App Attest assertion object. Android: Play Integrity verdict token. OMIT this field entirely if device lacks hardware attestation support. assurance_level will be software_only.

device_id_hash.description: SHA-256 of device identifier. iOS: SHA-256(UIDevice.identifierForVendor). Android: SHA-256(ANDROID_ID). Hash only — raw device ID never transmitted.

low_light_detected.description: true if ambient light sensor < 50 lux during capture

motion_detected.description: true if accelerometer detected significant motion

front_camera_confirmed.description: true if front-facing camera was used

public_key.description: Base64-encoded DER public key. Algorithm: EC P-256 (secp256r1). Server uses this field to verify signature.

signature.description: Base64-encoded ES256 signature over canonical JSON of all fields except this signature field, keys sorted alphabetically, no whitespace. Algorithm: ECDSA with P-256 curve and SHA-256 hash.
